description: Locations and characteristics of electricity substations (33 kV or larger), Great Britain, 2018 is a data set deposited in bl.nerc by its authors A.A. Lovett, G. Sünnenberg (University of East Anglia). The data consists of names, types, voltages, constraint status and national grid references for 56,865 electricity substations (33 kV or larger) in Great Britain in 2018. It was compiled from information on individual transmission or distribution network operator websites and interpreted to produce a classification of constraint status (where applicable). Coverage: national (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. Formats: CSV. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
